NITI Aayog defends MCQ entrance exams, citing efficiency

A NITI Aayog member has defended the use of multiple-choice question (MCQ) formats in entrance examinations, stating they are an effective way to test intelligence in a shorter time. This defense comes amidst criticism of the MCQ format. The Aayog maintains that MCQs are a valid and efficient method for assessing candidates.
